check.generator: GenObl.run refuses (exit 2) unless the summary's shape (storage fields, function at the selector incl. body) equals the imported contract's (structural, by reprStr), and no traced valuation refutes a sequent
check.kernel: generated Obl proves shape_eq : shapeOf <imported contract> sel = some <summary shape> by kernel_rfl, and runs : Runs <imported contract> sel minFuel br := runs_of_summary <summary theorem> shape_eq; tree is rewritten through shape_eq
check.summary_theorem: Verify.LoopSource.Equiv.CounterSummary.summary_ok : SummaryOk bumpSel (2^256+8) (vcFields, bumpFn) bumpBr, from the loop route's body_runs_vc

positive.invocation: lake env lean --run Certified/CounterRun/Loops/bump/Gen.lean (T7 gen_driver output + summary? := some Verify.LoopSource.Equiv.CounterSummary.summary + import Verify.LoopSource.Equiv.Counter.Summary)

wrong_branch.mutation: require's sides swapped in the summary
wrong_branch.stderr: the summary's tree disagrees with the MIR: sequent 27 has a counterexample

wrong_bound.mutation: count + n <= limit replaced by count + n < limit
wrong_bound.stderr: the summary's tree disagrees with the MIR: sequent 37 has a counterexample

wrong_step.stderr: the summary's tree disagrees with the MIR: sequent 32 has a counterexample

other_function.mutation: summary's shape is the imported increment()
other_function.stderr: the summary was proved for another function or body than the imported one

mutated_source.mutation: source loop body count++ -> count += 2 (CounterMut.sol sha256 367cc8db…), old summary
mutated_source.stderr: the summary was proved for another function or body than the imported one

note: the three wrong-summary negatives are refused by the trace probe before emission; were they emitted, shape_eq would hold but a V-module would fail (no counterexample-free sequent set), so the kernel does not depend on the probe
